text:
alice: Hey — spinning up a new GCP project for the APAC inference pilot (redwood-apac-pilot-02). Need help getting quota increases and project approvals in place before next week. :wave:
ben: What quotas specifically? region, GPU types, external IPs?
alice: region = asia-southeast1 (Singapore). Need: 8x A100 40GB (on-demand), 12x L4, and a fallback of 4x H100 in case A100 supply is constrained. Also requesting 50 spare external static IPs for NAT/bastion and VPC peering egress bump (we'll route cross-project traffic).
chirag: Adding the typical checklist — billing account linked, org policy exceptions if any, and service account for autoscaler. I started a draft GCP support case body: paste below.
chirag: ```
Project ID: redwood-apac-pilot-02
Billing account: 0123-4567-8901
Org: redwood-prod
Requested quotas:
 - A100 (a2-family) GPUs: quota increase to 8 GPUs in asia-southeast1
 - L4 GPUs: quota increase to 12 GPUs in asia-southeast1
 - H100 GPUs: soft request for 4 GPUs (fallback)
 - External IPs: 50
 - VPC network egress: increase to 10TB/month (initial)
Justification: Production inference for pilot customers, latency-sensitive, will run reserved capacity pools. Initial throughput estimate ~2k vGPU-hours/day. Contact: alice@redwood.dev
```
infra-bot: Reminder: "Please include projected QPS, expected token rate, and whether instances are preemptible."
alice: QPS ~150 requests/s at peak, average 1k tokens/request, ~150k tokens/s peak. Instances will be non-preemptible for latency SLOs.
sre-lead: FYI H100 availability in asia-southeast1 is spotty — we should include alternative regions (asia-east1) in the request or ask GCP sales to prioritize capacity. Also double-check VPC quotas: routes, interconnect IPs, and Egress NAT throughput.
oncall: Noted. We'll need network egress budget for cross-region fallbacks. Estimate Additional egress ~2TB/month if fallback to asia-east1.
finance: Back-of-envelope cost: A100 on-demand ~ $4.50/hr (per GPU) -> 8 GPUs * 24 * 30 * $4.5 ≈ $25.9k/month. L4 approx $0.90/hr -> 12 * 24 * 30 * $0.9 ≈ $7.8k/month. H100 unknown/capacity premium; add buffer. Also factor egress and static IP charges (~$150/mo).
ben: I'll open the support case and request GCP account team involvement to expedite H100. Ben -> @GCP-sales contact in case notes.
ben: Creating case now, adding cost justification and traffic profile. Will paste case number once created.
chirag: Also adding service account roles: compute.admin, serviceusage.serviceUsageAdmin, and project IAM binding for infra-oncall. Remember to create quota request with "subject_to_approval_by_organization_admin" flagged if needed.
alice: Can someone confirm that billing account 0123-4567-8901 has the proper quota link and that we can attach the project? I ran `gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-apac-pilot-02 --billing-account=0123-4567-8901` and got permission denied.
ben: That usually means the billing account doesn't include the new sub-project. I'll grant `roles/billing.projectManager` to the cloud-ops SA.
oncall: Quick checklist for approvals: org admin approval, security review for static IPs (we sometimes block external IPs by policy), cost center sign-off from finance.
finance: I've added a provisional approval for pilot costs up to $40k/month. We'll re-evaluate after usage data.
chirag: Pasted the support case #CAS-2026-APAC-88. GCP responded asking for a detailed workload matrix and estimated sustained concurrency per model. I attached our prompt distribution and model footprints.
ben: GCP asked if we can accept preemptible/backfilled capacity for some batch workloads — we said no for production, yes for background evals. Included that in reply.
alice: Two action items for folks: 1) Ben to follow up with GCP sales for H100 allocation, 2) Chirag to file IAM & org policy exceptions with security. I'll own the quota case communications.
sre-lead: Also recommend we request temporary burst quota vs permanent, so we can scale down after pilot. GCP sometimes approves burst faster.
infra-bot: Ticket CAS-2026-APAC-88 status updated -> "Support: Additional info required" :eyes:
ben: Updated the case with burst vs permanent numbers and attached our rollout timeline. Next check-in tomorrow noon PT.
alice: Thanks — ping me for approval signoffs. :thumbsup:
